items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface and a frame with parts: `Card.Header`, `Card.Body`, `Card.Footer`

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A label, a control, a hint and an error: the ids and the ARIA are `createField`'s

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: APG modal dialog: a scrim, a panel on the surface, focus in and back, Escape or the backdrop to close, and an `animated` panel that reverses from where it is when it is interrupted

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: An edge-anchored panel on Dialog (Modal): a side rail or a bottom sheet, with the focus trap, Escape, the backdrop, the scroll lock and the focus return — and an `animated` slide that leaves the page only when it has finished

items.name: panzoom
items.title: Pan and zoom
items.description: One image in a frame: drag or flick to pan, pinch or Ctrl/⌘ + wheel to zoom, a double click or Reset to go back, and the keys and the live value that stand in for every gesture

items.name: scrollspy
items.title: Scrollspy
items.description: A table of contents whose current entry is the last heading to pass the top of its scroll container, indented by level and marked `aria-current=location`

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A reading-progress bar on one element: a scroll timeline scrubs the fill where the browser has one, and `createScrollProgress` keeps the `progressbar` value and drives the same fill where it has not

sections.title: 1. Section
sections.text: A bar that fills with the scroll is the one progress indicator a reader never has to look away for. The pane below is the scroll container: the bar reads its own nearest scrollport for the animation, and the primitive reads the same element for the value. Where the browser has scroll-driven animations the fill is the compositor's; where it has not, the inline scale is a listener's. Either way the number a screen reader hears is the same one the pane's position says.

items.name: diagram
items.title: Diagram
items.description: A graph of nodes and edges drawn in SVG: one roving tab stop over the nodes, arrows that follow the layout, Enter for the outgoing edges of a node, and a live region that says where the user is

items.name: picker
items.title: Picker
items.description: A native `select` whose options carry a name, the fact the choice turns on and a note, in aligned columns — `appearance: base-select` where the browser has it (and a precise pointer), the ordinary control and the option text everywhere else

items.name: canvas
items.title: Canvas
items.description: A canvas of cards on @cssints/headless's createCanvas: drag, marquee, arrow keys, zoom, and the primitive's own live region — plus the two things a skin adds, a minimap that is also a camera and a drag that pulls the camera when it reaches the frame's edge

items.name: shortcuts
items.title: Shortcuts
items.description: A keyboard-shortcuts sheet opened by `?`: the kit's dialog with a group per area and a key cap per chord, and the registry the page binds its own chords to

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: APG carousel: auto-rotating slides that pause on hover and focus, previous and next, dots and a count as the indicator, arrow keys on a focused slide, and a touch swipe

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field on the neutral theme, and the control `Field` puts in by default

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A toolbar: `role=toolbar`, a name, and a size the controls inside read as their context

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: Buttons in one line: the corners two neighbours share and the border between them are the group's, not a prop's

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: APG switch on @cssints/headless, on the neutral theme, with its scenario test

items.name: disclosure
items.title: Disclosure
items.description: APG disclosure on @cssints/headless, on the neutral theme, with its scenario test

args.children: A disclosure is one button and the panel it shows. The chevron turns with `aria-expanded`.
A disclosure is one button and the panel it shows. The chevron turns with `aria-expanded`.

A disclosure is one button and the panel it shows. The chevron turns with `aria-expanded`.

items.name: disclosure-animated
items.title: Animated disclosure
items.description: A disclosure whose panel animates on `@cssints/machine`: an interrupted animation reverses from where the box is, a cancelled one's completion is ignored, a hover burst is debounced, and reduced motion skips the transition

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: APG button and toggle button: `tone` and `size` variants, and `render` for a link

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: APG checkbox, including the mixed tri-state, on @cssints/headless

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio group
items.description: APG radio group with roving tabindex or aria-activedescendant focus

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: APG tabs: the platform's single tab stop, automatic or manual activation, wrapped arrows

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: APG accordion: multiple or single expansion, headed triggers, collapsible

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A rule between two groups: `role=separator` with its orientation, or a decorative `role=none`

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small label in three tones, a pill at 999px because the theme's steps stop at 16px

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder box that pulses only when the reader has not asked for less motion

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: APG alert: a title and a body in a live region, with an `invalid` tone

items.name: dropzone
items.title: Drop zone
items.description: A file drop target: a dashed zone, a browse button over the primitive's hidden input, and a live region for the last batch

items.name: columns
items.title: Columns
items.description: A column chart as a list: one bar per category, its height the value, and the number in text above it

args.label: Requests per 25 ms bucket, last hour
Requests per 25 ms bucket, last hour
Requests per 25 ms bucket, last hour

items.name: bars
items.title: Bars
items.description: A multi-series bar chart as a table: each bar a background sized by its value, and the header row a legend of checkboxes that hide a series

items.name: donut
items.title: Donut
items.description: A donut chart as a list: each slice the item's clipped `conic-gradient()` ring, with its name and share in the row

items.name: spotlight
items.title: Spotlight
items.description: A card whose light follows the pointer: the position as `--spot-x` / `--spot-y`, the gradient under the content, and the light on hover or on focus inside

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A stat tile: the metric's name, the value as `<data>`, the change in words on a chip and its samples as a sparkline

items.name: heatmap
items.title: Heatmap
items.description: A heatmap as a table: every cell a square coloured by `color-mix()` from its share of the scale

items.name: board
items.title: Board
items.description: A design system on a DOM plane: token cards with their value and their rule, the components that use them, a line per use, a token's value you type into and watch the whole map follow, and an outline that reads the plane in order

items.name: scale
items.title: Scale
items.description: A bar list whose scale is its own largest value, read out of layout: one `auto` grid column measures the widest mark, `round(100cqw / 1px)` in a registered `@property` carries it back as a number, and a counter prints it — no script computes the scale, and the numbers are text where container units are missing

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: APG meter: a track and the fill of the value, on `createMeter`

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A sparkline as a list of samples: the line is CSS (`hypot` and `atan2`), with no SVG and no canvas

args.label: Requests per second, the last 20 samples
Requests per second, the last 20 samples
Requests per second, the last 20 samples

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: APG breadcrumb: a trail whose current page is marked `aria-current=page` and painted from it

items.name: treeview
items.title: Tree view
items.description: APG tree view: roving focus, expanded rows and levels on `createTreeview`

items.name: treegrid
items.title: Tree grid
items.description: APG treegrid: a file tree with columns, the expander in the name cell, roving focus across rows and cells, and the selected row painted from `aria-selected`

items.name: feed
items.title: Feed
items.description: APG feed: articles that load as the end of the list scrolls into view, with the primitive's position and size, a loading sentinel and the status line a screen reader hears

items.name: player
items.title: Player
items.description: A media player on an injected `PlaybackAdapter`: a video frame or an audio bar, play and pause named from the stage, the m:ss time, a seek slider with the APG keys, and a mute toggle

args.label: A short film about the coast
args.title: The coast at dusk

args.label: A short film about the coast
args.title: The coast at dusk

items.name: resizable-panels
items.title: Resizable panels
items.description: A group of panes with a separator between each pair: drag or use the arrows, Home and End jump a pair to its bounds, Enter collapses and restores, and the primitive keeps the layout summing to 100%

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: APG menu button: one trigger, a list with a roving tab stop, arrows, Home and End, Escape and a click outside to close; a variant gives the rows checkbox and radio items

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: APG menu and menubar: a roving bar whose menus float under their items, rows with one tab stop, and nested submenus that open beside the parent row

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: APG tooltip: a text bubble on hover and on focus, wired to its trigger by `aria-describedby`

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A non-modal panel anchored to a trigger: a dialog surface that flips at the viewport edge, closes on an outside press or Escape, and returns the focus

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: A calendar in a popover: a 6x7 month grid with arrows, Home and End, PageUp and PageDown, min and max, and the chosen day on the trigger

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: APG select-only combobox: the button that shows the chosen label is the combobox, a floating listbox follows it with `aria-activedescendant`, and Enter, Tab or a click commits

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command palette
items.description: A modal dialog with a search field: the primitive filters the commands, `aria-activedescendant` marks the active row, and arrows, Enter, Escape and a hotkey are its keys

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line field styled like `Input`, and the control `Field` puts in with `render`

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: APG slider: the rail, the fill and the thumb, with the fill's share of the rail from `aria-valuenow`

items.name: slider-multithumb
items.title: Range slider
items.description: APG multi-thumb slider: two thumbs whose bounds follow each other, and the interval between them as the fill

items.name: spinbutton
items.title: Spinbutton
items.description: APG spinbutton: a number field with steppers it disables at the bounds, and the id a `Field` names it by

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: Checkbox group
items.description: APG tri-state checkbox group: three of the kit's `Checkbox`, and the all/none/mixed parent derived from them

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A queue of toasts in a portalled fixed stack: info, success and error tones, a close button, and a countdown that pauses while the pointer or the focus is on the toast

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A data table on a native `<table>`: sortable headers whose arrow is `aria-sort`, row selection with a select-all that covers the rendered rows, a numeric column right-aligned from the column's hint, and an optional window over 10 000 rows that keeps `aria-rowcount` and every `aria-rowindex`

items.name: modifiers
items.title: Modifiers
items.description: A table you reshape in place: every transformation is a unit on a rail — a tint, a bar, an order — with its span, its input column and its place in the stack in the unit's own panel, and the values still cells of text

cells.title: The Seed of the Sacred Fig

args.caption: Oscar hopefuls, 2026: the audience's score, the critics', and the gross

items.name: virtual-list
items.title: Virtual list
items.description: A scrolling list on `createVirtualizer`: only the declared rows are built (10 000 rows cost a screenful), two spacers stand in for the rest, and every row announces its place in the whole set

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: A page list in a nav: the current page is `aria-current=page` and painted from it, the elided runs are text, the ends stay in place, and one live status announces the count

items.name: knob
items.title: Knob
items.description: A dial on `createKnob`: a three-quarter arc, a pointer and the value in the middle, turned by a drag, the wheel or the arrows, Page Up and Page Down, Home and End

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: A trace waterfall on `createTimeline`: a name column indented by depth, each span a bar at its share of the whole trace, a ruler of nice ticks, the cursor and selection keys, and the selected span's status line

items.name: reorder
items.title: Reorderable list
items.description: A list whose order the reader changes: a drag handle, Alt+↑ / Alt+↓ on the focused row, each row's position, and a status line that says where it moved

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable picker: the field filters a listbox as the reader types, `aria-activedescendant` marks the active option, and Enter, Space or a click chooses it

items.name: listbox
items.title: Listbox
items.description: A plain listbox on `createListbox`: one roving tab stop, arrows, Home and End, type-ahead, and single or multiple selection with a check mark

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: A link on `createLink`: a native `<a href>` or a custom `role=link` with its own tab stop and Enter, a muted tone, and the current page marked `aria-current=page`

items.name: hardware
items.title: Hardware (skin 01)
items.description: A second look after SPEC-01: a moulded faceplate, keys standing in their holes, a rocker, a slide switch, a fader with a printed scale, a dial with a tick arc, an LCD, a lamp and a bar graph — one OKLCH key colour turned into every role, in a plain sheet scoped to `[data-skin="01"]`
